insight: For Scotland, hydration breaks in the 2026 World Cup have generally been a positive turning point, with the team gaining momentum in 5 out of 6 breaks, indicating a slight increase in performance after the brief pause. When Scotland was pressing before a hydration break, they were able to maintain their momentum afterwards, and even saw a slightly larger increase in performance, with an average gain of 0.200 minutes. Overall, these statistics suggest that hydration breaks have been a beneficial aspect of Scotland's strategy, allowing them to recharge and come back stronger in the majority of cases.
